Senior Software Engineer, Frontend

About the job

Our team builds the platform that thousands of people rely on every day. You will own features end to end, work closely with design and product, and ship to production weekly. Requirements: 4+ years of TypeScript, experience with React or Vue, strong communication, and a habit of writing tests.

What you'll do

  • Ship product features
  • Mentor engineers
